findings.title: `queued` timestamp is evaluated only once at module import
findings.body: `timezone.now()` is executed while the dataclass is defined, so every `AssignmentSource` created by a worker process receives the same `queued` value until that process restarts. This makes the context payload's queue time inaccurate (and would break any future age/ordering/expiry logic based on it). Use `field(default_factory=timezone.now)` so each source records its own creation time.
